items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 138:1
items.html: (To the question) What are the hairs, which are more material than the vapor of the mouth? The returning light that rises from the screen in the Malchut of the Galgalta of AA, which is the aspect Dalet of the clothing that is included with the aspect Gimel of coarseness in the Mocha Stima'ah, this returning light has no spreading at all below the head. And the reason is that this aspect Dalet, which is called the mouth, is completely pure from its own aspect, and all the aspect of the coarseness in it came to it from the aspect Gimel, which is the aspect of the vapor of the nose; and therefore the vapor of the mouth itself is hidden from the lower ones. However, the hairs are also an aspect Dalet like the mouth, but they are more material than the vapor of the mouth, because there is in them also from the aspect of the coarseness of the Malchut of the first restriction, since they do not serve except in the place of the Reisha de Lo It Yeda, as is known. And it is the secret of the Daat of the Reisha de Lo It Yeda, which is clothed in the air, from which the stature of the Hochma of the thirty-two paths is bestowed through the Mocha Stima'ah to Aba and Ima. And it is found that the main bestower is the Mocha Stima'ah, through the vapor of the nose, which is the aspect of the screen in the Yesod of the Mocha Stima'ah, for it receives from the hairs and descends to the place of Aba and Ima in the KHB of AA, and makes there a coupling upon the aspect of the Daat of the hairs, which are included in the screen of the Yesod of its aspect Gimel, which is called the nose; and in this manner it bestows the Mochin of AB to Aba and Ima, as above in Answers 78 and 79, concerning the matter of the bowing of the head. See there. And see Answers 32 and 33, concerning the matter of the vapor of the mouth and the nose. (Item 218).
